title: In sentences: ordinals — третьего, двадцать пятом…

blocks.text: «Ordinal numerals are used and declined as Adjectives in both Singular and Plural. In compound ordinal numerals only the last element is actually an ordinal, and only this element is declined.» «The first part is in the Genitive case: **пятидесятый**, **двухсотый**. This part does not change in declension.»
DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 72, pp. 37–38. · Every form on this page is the OpenCorpora dictionary's own (CC BY-SA 4.0), put together by the rules quoted above.

Real sentences: from the library's public-domain books (author and title above each), and from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), shown with their translation. The numeral is blanked; type it in the form the sentence needs. ё and е are both accepted.

exercises.q: Начиная с тысяча девятьсот ___ (90-го, gen. sg. m.) года, одиннадцать студенток удостоились этой награды.
exercises.prompt: *Since 1990, eleven female students received the award.*
exercises.why: **тысяча девятьсот девяностого** — round tens and hundreds (30, 50, 100, 800…) take the genitive plural (девяностый → девяностого).

exercises.why: **первый → первых** (gen. pl., agreeing with вечеров: из + genitive). Declines like новый. Ending -ые → -ых.

whys.ord: «Ordinal numerals are used and declined as Adjectives in both Singular and Plural. In compound ordinal numerals only the last element is actually an ordinal, and only this element is declined.» «The first part is in the Genitive case: пятидесятый, двухсотый. This part does not change in declension.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 72, pp. 37–38.
